title: DreamConsolidationState
description: Consolidation daemon state, read/written by src/L0_to_L4_consolidation/server/main.py:_load_state/_save_state. Persisted at Config.L4_narrative_path/state.json (default data/L4-narrative/state.json). Tracks cooldown timestamps/counters gating L1->L2->L3->L4 promotion and dream cycles.

schema_version.description: Added in Phase 1 item 1.6; older on-disk state.json files predating this change do not carry it, and are upgraded in place by _load_state's setdefault on next read.

last_promote_l1_l2.description: turn_count value at last L1->L2 promotion (compared by count, not wall-clock)

last_promote_l2_l3.description: Unix epoch seconds (float) of last L2->L3 promotion

last_promote_l3_l4.description: Unix epoch seconds (float) of last L3->L4 promotion

last_dream.description: Unix epoch seconds (float) of last dream cycle; 0 forces the cooldown to be considered expired
